scope: same fourteen one-time USD sandbox scenarios; browser replay is not money proof
required_from_backend: approved sandbox credential refs and retention
bounded session cleanup and unknown outcome handling

scenarios.title: Create, approve, capture and return
scenarios.expected_domain_observation: Reconcile shop order, provider capture and amounts; HTTP success alone is insufficient.

scenarios.title: Buyer cancellation
scenarios.expected_domain_observation: No paid/fulfilled state or replacement payment inferred from browser cancellation.

scenarios.title: Declined payment
scenarios.expected_domain_observation: No fulfillment; preserve observed provider outcome and associated intent.

scenarios.title: Pending then completed
scenarios.expected_domain_observation: Pending is not paid; later verified completion produces one transition.

scenarios.title: Payer action when supported
scenarios.expected_domain_observation: Record actual account/product support; unavailable required flow is a hold, not a silent skip.

scenarios.title: Duplicate submit / two tabs
scenarios.expected_domain_observation: One logical payment intent and one economic effect; losing response cannot overwrite winner.

scenarios.title: Lost response / restart / retry
scenarios.expected_domain_observation: Preserve original API-specific idempotency identity; reconcile unknown effects without fresh-key retry.

scenarios.title: Full refund / repeated refund
scenarios.expected_domain_observation: Use original API/account/object IDs; check remaining amount; distinguish pending and completed; no excess refund.

scenarios.title: IPN authenticity and business checks
scenarios.expected_domain_observation: Preserve raw bytes; verified identity, recipient, amount and currency before financial effects.

scenarios.title: IPN pending/completed/duplicate/late pending
scenarios.expected_domain_observation: State-aware dedupe; one fulfillment; no state regression; later legitimate financial events retained.

scenarios.title: Webhook authenticity / duplicate / wrong listener
scenarios.expected_domain_observation: Bind raw-body verification to sandbox app/listener; mock simulator evidence stays separate.

scenarios.title: Callback outage / reconciliation
scenarios.expected_domain_observation: Durable receipt before acknowledgement; no effect before verification; absent reporting is not proof of no charge.

scenarios.title: Order persistence and restart
scenarios.expected_domain_observation: Retain order/payment correspondence and state; no concurrent flat-file writers or restoration over new payments.

scenarios.title: Amount / currency tampering
scenarios.expected_domain_observation: USD shop charge must equal trusted order amount and intended recipient; no multicurrency support inferred.
